findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: check_connection, get_ai_traffic, get_ctr_curve, analyze_cannibalization, get_branded_performance, get_page_performance, get_core_web_vitals, get_indexing_tracker, list_url_inspections, list_sitemaps, get_bing_performance, set_bing_site · Private data: get_capabilities, check_connection, set_bing_site, set_bing_key · Public sink: get_position_distribution, get_branded_performance, get_longtail_clusters, get_query_shape_trend, get_core_web_vitals, get_indexing_tracker, get_genai_impressions, generate_seo_report, set_branded_terms · Destructive: list_sites, get_timeseries, find_decaying_content, get_branded_performance, detect_anomalies, detect_change_points, get_indexing_tracker, generate_seo_report, get_weekly_digest, set_bing_key.

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
